firmographics.narrative_md: Hudson Valley Credit Union is a credit union. It reports $8.0 billion in total assets and has operated since 1963. It is regulated by NCUA (post Jan 2026) and employs approximately 1,110 people across 40 branches. Its overall digital maturity is assessed at 2.3 out of 5 across the DMA capability framework.

issue_register.title: Citation density 39 unique E-IDs is above Layer 1 threshold (30) but below Layer 2 aspirational target of 50. P3 and P4 deep dives have lighter citation density vs P1 and P2.
contradiction_log.csv and reasoning_chain_log.json were generated during governance audit rather than during Layer 1 scoring phase. Layer 1 should produce these natively.
Evidence_Index URL validation: a small number of T4 evidence items have shortened URLs that may not be directly accessible. All T1/T2 items have full, specific URLs.

Evidence reuse concentration: E-067 (LeadIQ tech stack) used in >60 subcap mappings as the primary 'absence' evidence for confirmed technology gaps. This is by design (single-source absence confirmation) but warrants disclosure.

4 contradictions documented — all classified as SOFT (scope-separation resolutions). No HARD contradictions were identified. While this is positive, the complete absence of HARD contradictions warrants noting: it may indicate that evidence collection was thorough enough that no genuinely conflicting facts were encountered, OR that contradictions were not systematically surfaced during Phase 4.5.
